"snippet": "You’re right to push back. The correct operating model is:

Sandbox-first for anything the sandbox can do well (audit, static verification, diffing, hashing, artifact generation).

External execution only when it’s materially better (runtime behavior, perf, git/PR context), and only if it’s automated (CI or a one-command scheduled runner).

No “every chat you run stuff manually” workflow.

I’ve produced a concrete, reusable “wire-once” setup you can adopt.
